# IKEMaker All-Screen Control-to-Route Audit

This is a bounded evidence matrix, not a completion claim. A route is marked behavior-tested only when a current test executes the relevant host or generated-client transition. Registry or string discovery alone is inventory evidence. Physical QA remains explicit until it is performed.

Current registry baseline: **65 surfaces** — 42 shared-chrome, 5 deferred-chrome companions, 18 intentionally local/native/excluded surfaces. The generated viewer-contract audit currently reports 0 unregistered surfaces, 0 owner mismatches, and 0 missing required shared chrome.

Control reachability is only one completion axis. The companion `data/IKEMaker-End-to-End-Workflow-Audit.md` and structured JSON trace primary workflows from entry through source/owner selection, forks, retained settings/drafts, review, actual output, return route, and cancellation/recovery. A registered command or click dispatch does not prove a workflow.

## Evidence legend

- **Host/client behavior tests**: executable route or state-transition coverage exists.
- **Inventory + shared-toolbar contract**: the surface and common chrome route are proven, but specialist body controls are not yet fully traced.
- **Inventory proven**: the surface is registered and owned; local controls still require route/state evidence.
- **Physical QA**: manual visual, focus, keyboard, screen-reader, mode, context, and narrow-layout verification remains required.

## Cross-surface findings and fixes

| Finding | Fix/evidence | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Dynamic Visual Authoring Browser view type caused the contract audit to abort. | The audit now resolves the exact `createPanel({ viewType: VIEW_TYPE })` handoff and fails closed for unknown dynamic factories; `viewer_contract_audit.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| Paste and line-comment actions were wrongly disabled at an empty cursor; Cut/Copy lost native empty-selection semantics. | Text availability now distinguishes selection-required transformations from writable cursor actions; `viewer_toolbar_availability.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| Missing body owners could leave menu actions enabled as silent no-ops, while local refresh could erase host-disabled reasons. | Host and local gates are combined independently; actual client `refreshMenu` missing/appearing-owner and host-reason transitions execute in `viewer_toolbar_client_availability.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| Quick icons, favorites, and keyboard action search could drift from menu availability or hide disabled reasons from keyboard users. | Actual client mirror functions now execute enabled/disabled transitions; search renders the reason as visible text; `viewer_toolbar_client_availability.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| SFFv1 limitations were not guaranteed to be disclosed at the point of use. | Legacy archives show a compatibility notice: preview/export/transfer available, only axis editing writes today, expanded editing planned; `sff_viewer_experience.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| AIR Transfer Copy Selected was enabled with no selection and could dispatch an empty or forged physical-index list. | The client now disables Copy with visible selection guidance, re-enables after selection, and the host accepts only a unique non-empty exact physical-index set; `air_transfer_browser.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| SFF Transfer Copy Selected stayed enabled after Clear, producing a dead-end action. | The pinned source browser now disables Copy at zero marked sprites, shows the enabling route, preserves the role boundary, and re-enables after selection; `sff_transfer_browser.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| Visual Browser row keyboard handling intercepted Enter/Space from nested action buttons and dropped row-selection modifiers through synthetic click. | Row-only key handling preserves native child-button activation and passes Shift/Ctrl/Meta selection intent directly; `visual_authoring_browser_accessibility.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| Animate Thumbnails could be enabled in list/filtered states where no image could animate and disabled without a visible reason. | Availability now requires thumbnail view, animation data, and a visible thumbnail; the associated live status explains how to enable it and unavailable transitions stop playback; `visual_authoring_browser_accessibility.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| SND Transfer Copy Selected was active with zero selection and trusted previously retained host selection; SND filters lacked programmatic names. | Copy is source-only, disabled with visible guidance until selection, sends and validates the exact current physical indices before copying, and every filter has a stable accessible name; `snd_browser.test.js`, `snd_transfer_browser_routes.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| SND Browser Undo/Redo invoked unbound global editor history, so a focused webview could no-op or affect an unrelated native document. | Browser history now routes only to the exact live SND Viewer asset history, mirrors its availability with visible live reasons, rejects unavailable/late messages, and close/suspend/retarget invalidate the old browser state; `snd_browser.test.js`, `snd_browser_history_routes.test.js`, `viewer_history_loss_transition.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| SFF Browser Undo/Redo had the same unbound global-history defect. | Browser history now routes only to the exact live SFF Viewer saved-axis history, mirrors live Undo/Redo availability with visible reasons, rejects Transfer/disposed/unavailable/mismatched owners, and close/suspend/retarget invalidate the old browser state; `sff_browser_history_routes.test.js`, `viewer_history_exact_owner.test.js`, `viewer_history_loss_transition.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| AIR Actions Browser Undo/Redo dispatched global history while its webview was focused, so the command could no-op or target an unrelated editor. | The browser now names the AIR target, focuses and verifies the exact bound AIR source editor before dispatch, rejects unavailable or mismatched routes, and reports progress/results in a polite live status; `air_docking_history_routes.test.js`, `air_docking_float_rehydrate.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| Roster Manager Undo/Redo tried to open the bound select.def with webview focus preserved, while a legacy handler still dispatched unbound global history. | Both production and legacy routes now use one exact-document helper that moves focus to the bound select.def, rechecks current authority and returned editor ownership, and rejects mismatches before native history; `roster_r2_actual_panel.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| AIR Viewer universal Undo/Redo focused its AIR document but did not revalidate the viewer binding or active editor after the focus await. | The viewer now rejects busy/unavailable/Transfer-source requests, captures the exact AIR binding, revalidates path/generation/editor after focus, and fails closed on mismatch or retarget before native history; `air_viewer_history_routes.test.js`, `viewer_asset_undo_contract.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| Menu & Modes Undo/Redo opened its selected source without explicitly moving focus or verifying the returned/active editor before global native history. | History now focuses the exact navigator-selected system.def or select.def with `preserveFocus:false`, rechecks mutation authority and editor identity after the await, and sends no command on mismatch; `menu_modes_m2_mutations.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| AIR Transfer action rows exposed selection only through a visual outline, empty filters left an unexplained blank region, and a forged drop message could reach a Source callback. | Rows now expose `aria-pressed`, share the named live status, and render actionable empty guidance; the host accepts drop messages only in Destination role while Copy remains Source-only and exact-selection guarded; `air_transfer_browser.test.js`, `air_transfer_browser_routes.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |
| Palette Workshop companion tabs and selected list items relied on visual styling, its filter/status were unnamed or non-live, empty searches looked broken, and mirrored control-pane tabs lacked tab semantics. | Browse and control-pane tabs now expose tab/tabpanel relationships and live selected state; search and result groups are named; selected items expose `aria-pressed`; filtered/total counts and actionable empty/connection states are polite live guidance; `palette_companion_accessibility.test.js`. | Contract-tested |
| Stage background layout/toggle state was color-only, boundary navigation and selected-only actions disabled without guidance, and its comparison/context overlays lacked deterministic keyboard focus. | Navigation exposes pressed/selected/live state and actionable boundary reasons; display toggles expose `aria-pressed`; SFF/action prerequisites are distinct; comparison and context overlays support named semantics, focus transfer/restore, Tab containment, and Escape; all `stage*.test.js` suites pass. | Behavior-tested |
| Screenpack Arrow nudging existed but its canvas could not reliably receive keyboard focus; layer/guide state was visual-only; quick navigation, draft recovery, Lua Structure, and Compare lacked complete disabled guidance. | The canvas is tabbable and focuses on pointer use, toggles expose pressed state, disabled controls name their prerequisite, and comparison uses dialog/focus/Escape behavior; all `screenpack*.test.js` suites pass. | Behavior-tested |
| Storyboard silently dropped concurrent mutation activations, group Apply lacked an associated reason, and successful host refreshes posted a new model that the webview never consumed. | Client and host share a polite busy terminal contract, scene-dependent and group controls expose enabling guidance, and the webview now atomically commits newer authoritative models while the host preserves the exact scene number across refresh; all `storyboard*.test.js` suites pass. | Behavior-tested |
| Character Connection Tree boundary controls remained active as no-ops, layout buttons changed stored state without changing presentation, missing files were conveyed by border color alone, and rapid body or universal-toolbar Open/Refresh/Choose/navigation messages could queue behind an asynchronous action and later target a replacement graph. | Boundary/empty/pending controls now visibly disable with live guidance; Tabs/List/Cards render distinct responsive layouts and expose `aria-pressed`; missing rows add text; one synchronous exclusive-action gate covers body and toolbar entry, rejects duplicate/late routes, and keeps Choose compatible with close preparation; held-queue and notification-failure tests prove cleanup; `character_dependency_navigation_client.test.js`, `character_dependency_authority.test.js`, `character_dependency_real_close.test.js`. | Behavior-tested |

## Header information-architecture recommendation (reviewed design, not yet an implementation claim)

The global **Build** dropdown should become a combined duplicate-access creation list while each creator remains available in its existing specialist dropdown. The bounded proposed list is: new SFF, AIR, sound, CNS file, ZSS file, character, stage, screenpack, storyboard, palette, and master palette image. Only already working creation commands may be exposed; unavailable creators must remain omitted until they have a real route. Existing release, audit, and editing actions should remain in their truthful task categories rather than being relabeled as creation.

## Required completion gates

- Every specialist body control is mapped to a real owner/handler/destination or removed as obsolete.
- Every primary workflow is traced in the companion end-to-end workflow matrix with isolated artifact/content/owner evidence; repeated chooser/setup loops, lost choices, wrong destinations/defaults, stale context, and cancellation/retry recovery are resolved or explicitly retained as tested intentional forks.
- Every disabled state has visible, keyboard-reachable reason text and an actionable enabling route.
- Every excluded/deferred surface has tested local Close/Return/Focus/help escape paths and no orphaned mutation owner.
- Dynamic dialogs, empty states, mode changes, project/character/stage/screenpack/story contexts, and browser/viewer transitions are behavior-tested.
- Workspace, Simple, and Player modes receive physical keyboard/focus/narrow-layout checks on representative character, stage, screenpack, story, and project workflows.
- Independent New Dev review signs off the completed bounded packets through the shared communication log.
